subject.title: fix(ios): persist voice notes through offline delivery

question: Should maintainers land this PR as the durable offline attachment follow-up for iOS voice notes, including the v6 SQLite outbox migration and persist-first handling for pending attachments?
rationale: The patch looks technically coherent, but it changes stored user data and expands the previously online-only attachment boundary, which is a maintainer-owned upgrade and product-scope choice.

options.title: Land After Exact-Head Checks
options.body: Accept the durable outbox schema and generic pending-attachment persistence once required iOS/macOS CI and the stated simulator proof remain clean.

options.title: Narrow To Voice Notes First
options.body: Ask the branch to restrict durable offline persistence to voice-note attachments if generic offline image attachment queueing is not intended yet.

options.title: Pause For Stronger Device Proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a physical-device recording/send/reconnect proof is attached if simulator microphone proof is not enough for this surface.

recommendation.title: Land After Exact-Head Checks
recommendation.body: Accept the durable outbox schema and generic pending-attachment persistence once required iOS/macOS CI and the stated simulator proof remain clean.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the iOS voice-note feature on current main and is the clearest history-backed owner for deciding the follow-up offline-delivery scope.
